summary: Russia launched a massive overnight combined attack using Iskander-M, Zircon, and S-400 ballistic missiles from Bryansk and Kursk regions alongside 113 Shahed drones, with Ukrainian air defenses intercepting 87 targets. At least eight ballistic missiles struck Kyiv’s Desnyansky and Dniprovsky districts, hitting a shopping mall and injuring seven people, while a separate strike on a residential building in Kharkiv killed two. Russian forces advanced near Rai-Oleksandrivka on the eastern front.

Eight ballistic missiles hit Kyiv’s Desnyansky and Dniprovsky districts, striking a shopping mall and injuring seven civilians. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78780, @mon1tor_ua/78782, @UkraineNow/85545)
Two Zircon hypersonic missiles were reported over Kyiv during the attack. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78784, @mon1tor_ua/78786)

Enemy ground forces advanced near Rai-Oleksandrivka in Donetsk region. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24026)

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a large-scale overnight barrage combining ballistic missiles (Iskander-M, Zircon, S-400) and 113 Shahed drones, with Ukrainian defenses downing 87 aerial targets. Eight ballistic missiles struck Kyiv’s Desnyansky and Dniprovsky districts, damaging a shopping mall and wounding seven, while a Kharkiv residential strike killed two. On the ground, Russian troops pushed forward near Rai-Oleksandrivka in Donetsk oblast.

sections.threat_assessment: The overnight barrage demonstrates Russia’s capacity to synchronize ballistic missile and mass drone strikes across multiple axes, overwhelming air defenses and striking critical infrastructure in Kyiv. The use of Zircon hypersonic missiles and redeployment of Tu-160/Tu-95MS strategic bombers signals intent to sustain high-intensity long-range strikes. Ground advances near Rai-Oleksandrivka suggest continued offensive pressure in Donetsk. Ukrainian air defense interception rates remain high but are strained by volume and missile speed.
sections.regional_response: Norway’s commitment to integrate Ukraine’s DELTA system and provide at least $7 billion in 2027 military aid — prioritizing air defense and drones — reflects deepening European defense cooperation. The agreement explicitly excludes transfer of Ukrainian operational data, maintaining security boundaries. This partnership enhances NATO interoperability and signals long-term Western support for Ukraine’s defense industrial base.
sections.intelligence_notes: Real-time drone tracking via Telegram monitoring channels (mon1tor_ua, kpszsu, eRadarrua) provided granular early warning across ten oblasts, enabling civilian sheltering and air defense cueing. The Tu-160 relocation from the Far East to Engels indicates strategic bomber force regeneration after previous losses. Ballistic missile launches from Bryansk/Kursk and Crimea show diversified launch geography complicating pre-launch detection. Guided bomb strikes on Sumy and Zaporizhzhia highlight persistent tactical aviation threat near the front lines.
